name: Ayar Labs
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Ayar Labs is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors and funds that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Ayar Labs is a privately held semiconductor company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $150 million extension of its Series E round announced on September 10, 2026, brought the capital it raised in 2026 to $650 million. The Series E, announced on March 3, 2026, valued the company at $3.75 billion.

Founded in 2015 and based in San Jose, California, Ayar Labs designs optical chips, known as co-packaged optics, that connect AI processors with light in place of copper wiring. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.

table_note: Valuations are as announced by the company, except the Series B valuation, which the company did not disclose. No valuation was disclosed for the September 2026 extension or for the Series C1 and Series C rounds.
round_notes: In September 2026, Reuters reported that a group led by Antero Peak Group at Artisan Partners had bought $225 million of shares from early employees and investors in a secondary transaction that valued Ayar Labs at $5 billion. Ayar Labs has not announced that transaction.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Neuberger Berman led the Series E, which added Alchip Technologies, ARK Invest, Insight Partners, MediaTek, Qatar Investment Authority, Sequoia Global Equities and 1789 Capital as new investors. Advent Global Opportunities and Light Street Capital led the Series D, Capital TEN the Series C1 and Boardman Bay Capital Management the Series C. Other investors include Nvidia, AMD Ventures, Intel Capital, Wiwynn, GlobalFoundries, Lockheed Martin Ventures and Playground Global.
spv_sentence: SEC filings show one special purpose vehicle formed to invest in Ayar Labs, organized in 2026.
funds: One SEC-registered fund reports a position in Ayar Labs. As of July 31, 2026, ARK Venture Fund held 478,543 shares, which it valued at $33.5 million, or $70.00 per share.
sources: Sources: Ayar Labs' announcements of its September 2026 extension, Series E, Series D, Series C1, Series C and Series B; reports by Reuters (September 10, 2026) and SiliconANGLE (September 2026); ARK Venture Fund's Form N-PORT for July 31, 2026; and SEC Form D filings.
